title: Hearty Rich Turkish Beans Kuru Fasulye
description: A rich and comforting Turkish dish featuring beans in a flavorful sauce, perfect for a hangover cure or a hearty meal. This version is nut-free and uses almond essence for added depth.

ingredients.name: dried white beans
ingredients.notes: such as cannellini or navy beans

instructions: Rinse the dried white beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the soaked beans, then transfer them to a large pot with 4 cups of water.
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the beans for 45 minutes, or until they are tender.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, until it is darkened and fragrant.
Add the cooked beans, almond essence, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10-15 minutes, until the flavors have melded together and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the Turkish beans hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or dill if desired.
